name: Wazuh documentation
description: Learn endpoint monitoring, agents, security events, rules, and alerts using the official guides.
note: Running the full stack needs suitable hardware. Use current docs rather than old installation videos.

name: Splunk free courses
description: Build familiarity with log searches, events, fields, dashboards, and Splunk fundamentals.
note: Learning content and product or lab access can have different conditions.

name: Microsoft Learn: Sentinel and KQL
description: Study Microsoft security, Sentinel, KQL, cloud concepts, and investigation workflows.
note: Documentation is free; cloud exercises can incur charges. Do not provision Azure services without checking pricing.

name: Sigma detection rules
description: Explore community detection rules and learn how detection logic can be expressed portably.
note: Review each rule’s log-source requirements, false-positive notes, and license.

name: MITRE ATT&CK
description: Understand adversary tactics and techniques and use them to contextualise defensive detections.
note: A knowledge base, not a step-by-step course or proof a technique occurred.

name: Web Security Academy
description: Learn web security concepts through structured explanations and interactive training labs.
note: Practise in intended training environments only.

name: OverTheWire Bandit
description: Practise Linux command-line concepts through a beginner-friendly educational wargame.
note: Follow the rules and instructions provided by the game.

name: OWASP Juice Shop
description: Use an intentionally vulnerable training app to learn common web security issues.
note: Run in an isolated lab; never expose a vulnerable instance publicly.

name: TryHackMe free rooms
description: Explore guided exercises covering cybersecurity concepts, SOC skills, and security tooling.
note: Only selected content is free; other rooms/features may require payment.

name: CyberDefenders blue-team labs
description: Explore defensive investigations, threat hunting, and digital forensics exercises.
note: Check the access conditions for each individual lab.

name: Windows process creation auditing
description: Understand Windows process-creation auditing concepts and event details.
note: Do not change audit policy on managed devices without permission; use sample events for practice.
